summary.headline: Prefatory Cataloguing Remarks
summary.text: Prefatory remarks on the cataloguing of Ambrosian Greek manuscripts, explaining the inclusion of astronomical material, meteor omens, and magical formulas; manuscript descriptions are kept brief, textual supplements are bracketed, and thanks are given to Fr. Cumont and Fr. Boll.
